d: Join us at Accor, where life pulses with passion!

As a pioneer in the art of responsible hospitality, the Accor Group gathers more than 45 brands, 5,600 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and lifestyle destinations in 110 countries. While each brand has its own personality, where you will be able to truly find yourself, they all share a common ambition: to keep innovating and challenging the status-quo.
By joining us, you will become a Heartist®, because hospitality is, first and foremost, a work of heart.

You will join a caring environment and a team where you can be all you are. You will be in a supportive place to grow, to fulfil yourself, to discover other professions and to pursue career opportunities, in your hotel or in other hospitality environments, in your country or anywhere in the world!
You will enjoy exclusive benefits, specific to the sector and beyond, as well as strong recognition for your daily commitment.

Everything you will do with us, regardless of your profession, will offer a deep sense of meaning, to create lasting, memorable and impactful experiences for your customers, for your colleagues and for the planet.
Hospitality is a work of heart,
Join us and become a Heartist®.

We are looking for someone to act as a centre of excellence for general legal business operations support in the Middle East, predominantly focusing on UAE and Saudi Arabia legal matters. The role includes the management of local dispute resolution/litigation/arbitration, local outside counsel and local legal strategy; the provision of local corporate, labor and employment legal advice; real estate/facilities/regulatory support; and local crisis management representation.
q: 5+ years of work experience managing and advising on Middle East legal matters
Fluent in verbal and written English
High level of integrity and ethics
Ability to work independently under general guidance and or with self-initiative
Demonstrates effective management knowledge, leadership, and motivation in a dynamic business environment and can operate and perform within a matrix organization
Demonstrates exceptional planning, interpersonal and communication skills
Ability to handle multiple tasks and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment
Ability to adapt to lean methodology
PC skills with proficiency in word processing, spreadsheet, project, and presentation software

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.
TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.
r: Provide daily advice and counsel on legal operations matters
Manage, translate and implement legal policies and standards
Provide local legal and regulatory expert services to operations and functions
Interact and consult with relevant Legal GBU(s)/EMS as the centre of excellence for local law
Manage dispute resolution at the local level, including litigation and arbitration and major disputes in collaboration with the Regional Senior Legal Manager for Northern Europe & Middle East
Implement local Legal strategies for operations and establishments

Manage the relationships with outside counsels in relevant countries in collaboration with the Regional Senior Legal Manager for Northern Europe & Middle East, People & Culture and other functions. Control, monitor and report legal matters and outside legal spend in Legal Tracker
Support People & Culture on all labor and employment related matters
Provide legal “landlording” services, including legal support to facilities, real estate etc. and ensure freedom to operate through compliance with local legislation, local content and licenses
Legal representative for HSE incidents and crisis management
Coordinates Legal representation in regulatory and legal forums and trade associations
Supports the implementation of compliance policies, procedures and compliance activities
Reporting to Regional Senior Legal Manager for Northern Europe and Middle East

d: The incumbent will achieve the revenue and market share growth objectives through the assigned portfolio and through acquisition of new clients from the Corporate Banking sector. The job holder is expected to be adept with all aspects of banking services and shall suitably recommend banking, financial and risk related solutions to their clients on ongoing basis to ensure incremental market share growth. The incumbent is expected to have a thorough understanding of the local corporate banking sector and update themselves on the latest developments within the sector. The Job holder shall be required to carefully analyze the opportunities and challenges within the sector and communicate to the line management and explore suitable solutions on a regular basis.
q: University graduate with a degree in Business or Banking or Finance or any other related discipline.
Master’s degree in Management any other related discipline will be an added advantage.
08 - 12 years of total experience in financial services/banking industry, entailing responsibilities pertaining to the specific area of discipline.
Experience in business / relationship management in corporate banking, with strong understanding of the local banking industry.
r: Keep abreast of the industry or sector, its composition, players and competitive forces within the sector and the latest development within the sector, including regulatory guidelines.

Establish robust working relationships leading to acquisition of new clients and servicing of existing and new clients across product ranges available in the bank to enhance the market share and revenue growth for the bank.
Understand the wallet share of each client across product range/service and draw plans in close coordination with the TL/Section Head to increase the wallet share from each client for the bank.
Develop and maintain robust working relationships with internal/external stakeholders to facilitate and capitalize on functional / operational/ strategic needs.
Solicit new clients to bank from the corporate banking sector and ensure prompt servicing the existing clients on regular basis.
Monitor the portfolio on a regular basis to ensure facility renewals, credit ratings, documentations are done on timely basis and KYC and AML requirements are satisfied on an on-going basis.

Ensure cross sale of products including but not limited to trade finance, cash management, structured finance, corporate finance, treasury related, insurance and retail banking products and track the achievements against the assigned targets.
Contribute towards the preparation/amendment of policies and procedures within the section, in line with the regulatory/market environments / organizational mandates.

Work independently with the assigned portfolio of clients to understand their business needs and associated banking needs. Maintain a good working relationship and ensure that their banking needs are being catered to, as per the policies and procedures.
Handle preparation of credit application for new clients and ensure to review all credit applications from existing clients for annual reviews, one -off requests, facility enhancements etc.

Work closely with the team to examine the credit applications, including financial statements and translate the financial soundness of these clients onto credit assessments before providing credit recommendations to the Committee.
Ensure all credit applications duly incorporate the credit ratings, RAROC models, business and revenue model analysis, discussions on financials and risks inherent along with the mitigates.
Manage daily account-related banking activities of the clients comprising the respective portfolio and provide directions and instructions to the team in this regard.
